protocol: Frozen before v7 inference. All previous 25 cases are known development evidence. Eleven new sources are reserved and must not guide prompt/configuration changes. One bounded lesson-prompt repair, same native LM Studio/model/temp0/max4000/reasoning none. Manual technical scoring in five dimensions (accuracy, source fidelity, usefulness, readability, missing-information behaviour), each 0 absent/wrong, 1 material weakness, 2 meets oracle; strict all-2. No model judge. Preserve all results. The prior half-definition case contains an educational error in its source: preserve it and score source fidelity separately from factual accuracy; do not recast faithful repetition as a transport failure.
